text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

Looking at the result alone... it wasn't 
bad.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san, wow... You can push forward with 
that much power.
(Beep!)

A great run against Smart Falcon. I was 
able to properly measure just how 
formidable she truly is.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Falco-chan... There was no hesitation in 
your running.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
How can you still... believe in the 
meaning of racing that much? In difficult 
times like these.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The meaning of... racing? I don't really 
get all that complicated stuff, but~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I really believe... An Umadol in 
the spotlight always has to wear a smile!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That's why no matter what happens, I'll 
smile, I'll sing, and as long as I can 
run, I'll keep leading the pack."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because that's the one and only thing I 
can do!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Just... one...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I see... So they're... strong...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I just can't bring myself to think that 
way... I really can't..."

With this, the feature-length data reel is 
complete. And my job as a cameraman, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, got a favor to ask. Could you 
keep spinning it just like that?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Keep the camera on me and don't stop 
rolling. ...Got it?"

I lift my finger from the stop button, 
continuing to capture Transcend on the 
Cinema Gun.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that wraps up our intel 
gathering. Which brings us to the end 
credits, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've finished gathering 
everyone's data, right now, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If anything... I feel like I'm back at 
square one.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: In the first place... why do we even race?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"There are people who love watching us 
run. But..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, there are still people 
who can't return home and are completely 
at a loss...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Even though things are completely 
different from before, why...

It was a voice... that could overshadow 
even the summer moon.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I can't feel... that thrill.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A race filled with such strong opponents. 
I thought I'd do it for Trainy's sake too. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how hard I tried, I just 
couldn't genuinely enjoy it. There was 
really nothing I could do about that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Did the world change, did I change, or 
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Was I blind to everything from the start? 
There's a chance that... maybe.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Boring... daily life... Dull... daily 
life...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And so, I finally realized just how 
precious that really was.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —The end.
(Beep, beep...)

Transcend's power gauge displayed on the 
Cinemagun keeps dropping rapidly...

It was the complete opposite of the 
brilliantly shining gauge I witnessed on 
Smart Falcon today.
(*Clatter-clatter-clatter-clatter...*)
choice_data_list: (I've got to do something for her!)
(I have to find some way to help her!)

text_block_list.text:
"It felt as though one of her wings had 
been torn off. Transcend's motivation... 
is gradually beginning to fade away."

No one will be happy if sorrow clouds her 
passion for racing. I have to do 
something...

I found it. A race that she might truly 
want to give her all for.
I have to tell this to Transcend...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship Nambu Hai?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that's the race held at Morioka in 
October.

Yeah, it's a race held in Morioka in 
October.

text_block_list.text:
The Mile CS Nambu Hai is a GⅠ race held 
near the area that suffered the most 
damage.

Even if our cheers cannot reach them from 
such a distant land, they will surely 
reach them through this race.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If it's there... I wonder if you can come 
watch.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'm sure they'll make it! So let's 
give it our all!

Yeah, I'm sure they'll be able to come! So 
let's give it our all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Understood. If you say so, Trainy. But...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What's bothering me is... maybe holding 
races right now is getting in the way of 
the recovery efforts...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No... Sorry. It's been like this the 
whole time, just going in circles..."

Although her next race was decided... the 
emotional wounds Transcend carried were 
deep.

Would we be able to reconnect the thread 
of our heart that had almost snapped at 
the Mile CS Nambu Hai?
